1. **`Promise.all` for node/edge rendering** — `packages/mermaid-layout-tidy-tree/src/render.ts` and `packages/mermaid/src/rendering-util/layout-algorithms/cose-bilkent/render.ts` both use `Promise.all` when calling `insertNode`. 2. **`packages/mermaid-layout-tidy-tree/package.json`** — `peerDependencies.mermaid` is `"^11.0.2"`, but per project rules for monorepo packages it must be `"workspace:^"`.

3. **Dead code in `mindmapRenderer.ts`** — `_drawNodes` and `_updateNodeDimensions` are defined but never called in the new `draw` function. These appear to be left-over helpers from earlier drafts.

5. **CDN version placeholder** — `packages/mermaid/src/docs/config/tidy-tree.md` hardcodes `mermaid@11` instead of using the `<MERMAID_VERSION>` build-time placeholder.

7. **`isGroup` made optional in `types.ts`** — The field was required and discriminated `Node = ClusterNode | NonClusterNode`. Making it optional collapses the discriminated union.

8. **`detectType` call in `preprocess.ts`** — `processFrontmatter` now calls `detectType(text)` to set a default layout for mindmaps. This adds unexpected coupling and could throw if detection fails.

9. **Sequence diagram color casing** — `box aqua` (was `box Aqua`) in sequenceDiagram.spec.js changes the expected `.fill` value, which may be externally observable.

10. **Dead initial value in `layout.ts`** — `intersectionShift` is initialized to `50` then immediately overwritten to `30`; the initial value is never used.

11. **Non-null assertions in tests** — `layout.test.ts` uses `!` on `.find()` results, violating the project rule that favors optional chaining.

12. **`@ts-ignore` in `question.ts`** — Project rules require `@ts-expect-error` with a reason, not a bare `@ts-ignore`.

13. **Leading whitespace in Cypress test template literals** — `mindmap-tidy-tree.spec.js` has a leading space before `---` in frontmatter and an improperly indented closing backtick.
